notes: §1985:XI.4.2.3 SR2: "A RELEASE statement may be used only within the range of an input procedure associated with a SORT statement for the file-name whose sort-merge file description entry contains record-name-1." WalkProgram calls GateReleaseReturnRange below 2002, which seeds ProcedureReach.Closure (followGoTo) with the input procedures of SORTs naming the file and reports COBOL7081 for a RELEASE outside; a RELEASE in the declaratives is asked where no input procedure for its file exists (kb/Work PB5572: pb5572-release-in-declarative-no-input-procedure-85 refused, pb5572_release_in_declarative_of_input_procedure_85 runs). kb/Work PB5628 (wave 20262045): the range crosses a CALL (§1985:XI.4.4.4 GR7, "all statements that are executed as the result of a transfer of control by CALL"): VersionConformancePass.CalledFromRange computes, once per compilation group, the programs a CALL in a range activates (a literal CALL by externalized name, a CALL by identifier every program of the group, and each called program's own CALLs transitively), and GateReleaseReturnRange accepts their RELEASE; and StatementValidation.ResolveRecordName resolves a contained program's GLOBAL record of a non-GLOBAL SD or FD to that file at 85, the containing-program rule beginning at 2002 (§2002:13.16.25.2 SR3; 1985 has §1985:X.4.6.4 GR2 only). pb5628_release_in_called_contained_program_85 sorts AAA, GGG, ZZZ with GGG released by the contained program P2N, which IN-P CALLs; its control, where the only CALL of the releasing program follows the SORT, is refused COBOL7081.

next.reason: 1985 states as a syntax rule that 'A RELEASE statement may be used only within the range of an input procedure associated with a SORT statement' for its file, so a violating program is refused. 2023 has no such syntax rule (14.9.32.3 SR1-4 carry none); §2023:14.9.32.4 GR1 says it 'may be executed only' there and 'If it is executed at any other time, the EC-FLOW-RELEASE exception condition is set to exist', and §2023:14.9.40.4 GR13 sets EC-SORT-MERGE-ACTIVE when an output procedure's range executes a RELEASE. A compile-time refusal became a run-time exception condition.
